name: intuitem/ciso-assistant-community
description: One-stop-shop GRC platform for Risk Management, AppSec, Compliance, Audit, TPRM, Privacy, and Reporting with support for 100+ global frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, CIS, PCI DSS, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, and HIPAA with automatic control mapping.
score_rationale: Rapidly growing open-source GRC platform with 3.7k stars, actively maintained through March 2026, supporting the broadest framework coverage of any open-source GRC tool.
